# Clipr Website

> Clipr Website rebuilds a small business's website, every page it has today, from its current site: its photos, words and colours, made better. The design concept is free to look at; the finished website costs $199 paid once (£199 in the UK), with changes until the customer is happy and step-by-step help putting it live on their own domain. No monthly fee to us. Domain and hosting stay with the customer's own provider.

## Main pages
- [Clipr Website](https://cliprauto.com/website/): a new website for your business, every page, free to look at, $199 once (£199 in the UK)
- [About](https://cliprauto.com/about/): facts, price and what we do not do
